text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it raised its intermediate-term rating on Medallion Financial Corp to outperform from market performer. Long-term rating remains outperform, EVEREN said.

-- The move is based on EVEREN's expectations of price appreciation to $21 in the next six months. Shares of Medallion, a company that originates and services loans for the purchase of taxicab medallions and related assets, were unchanged at 17-1/2 Monday.

-- EVEREN said it expects Medallion to report progressively stronger year-over-year earnings per share comparisons, due to strong loan growth throughout the year, supplemented in the fourth quarter by taxi-top advertising beginning to make a meaningful contribution to net income.
